correctness.rationale: The spherical hemisphere Gram operator decomposes by signed azimuthal order into a 2x2 block with diagonal 1/2 and cross term I_m=∫_0^1 S_(ell,m)S_(ell+d,m). The associated-Legendre Sturm–Liouville Wronskian identity reduces I_m to boundary products divided by d(2ell+d+1); double factorials determine top coefficient and signs. Order-raising recurrences give |I_(m+1)|/|I_m|=R_m^{±1}, R_m>1 increasing, and two-step R_(m+1)/R_m>1 on the top parity class; opposite-parity modes are dominated by next top-parity mode, so |m|=ell unique. The next distinct top coefficient and spectral theorem give sharp stability gap. The squared B ratio at successive ell reduces to an exact rational expression with sign determined by q_d(ell)=2d²+2dell+d-4ell²-12ell-9; it is positive through ell=d-2 and negative from d-1, giving the unique peak. ell=0 and ell=1 central-mode edge cases are explicitly treated. Independent direct associated-Legendre hemisphere quadratures for ell up to 13 and d=3,5,7,9, plus peak checks to ell=25, corroborated ratios and top eigenspace; finite checks are not the all-degree proof.
residual_risks: Only scalar complex spherical harmonics, hemisphere and odd nonconsecutive two-degree gap d>=3. Even gap and general masks not claimed; sharp gap distance measured to entire maximizing eigenspace.

value.rationale: Sparse two-band harmonic packets are natural spectral concentration problems; determining the optimal azimuthal order, exact spectral rigidity and a nonmonotonic interior lower-degree peak is a qualitative structural result over all odd nonconsecutive gaps, beyond a numerical coefficient or a trivial restriction of a general rank law.

final_claim: For scalar spherical harmonics on S^2 supported on degrees ell and ell+d with odd d>=3, the hemisphere-concentration maximum is 1/2+B_(ell,d), with explicit positive factorial product, attained exactly in signed azimuthal orders +/-ell (one order for ell=0). The full order-wise spectrum and sharp spectral gap follow; for fixed odd d the coefficient B_(ell,d) has unique integer peak ell=d-1.
limitations: Only scalar complex spherical harmonics, hemisphere and odd nonconsecutive two-degree gap d>=3. Even gap and general masks not claimed; sharp gap distance measured to entire maximizing eigenspace.
